subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical umbrella for multi-agent orchestration stability while narrow lock/delivery fixes land, or should maintainers split and close it after assigning narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Current main has partial repairs, but the remaining work spans proven bugs and broader orchestration policy that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep umbrella plus narrow fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella and review focused fixes such as #86540 before reassessing closure.

options.title: Split then close umbrella
options.body: Promote narrower canonical issues for each remaining root cause and close this issue only after the split is explicit.

options.title: Sponsor orchestration redesign
options.body: Treat token-ring or metadata-only completion as a product-design effort rather than a bug-sweep repair.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella plus narrow fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella and review focused fixes such as #86540 before reassessing closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for session-lock and subagent architecture points to steipete.
